answer: Cross-epoch overlap consistency rule: each identity must answer a small hidden set of recurring tasks and match its own prior-epoch responses. A new identity begins in an oasis of low-value tasks. It must carry that behavioral trace into the wider task ocean before full access. Cloned or split profiles diverge on overlaps and get filtered; one mismatch blocks promotion like a crack in marble. Attacker cost: every Sybil must run and maintain a distinct consistent history across multiple epochs, paying separate compute, latency, and storage per identity.
